summary.repair_iteration_note: Repair-22 resolves the latest actionable Codex review findings for full memory-rule contract validation and embedded experience signature details, while preserving the already-repaired accepted-review-label behavior for active rules.
implemented_contracts: cmd/relia/main.go now validates memory rules for object_type, schema_version, id, kind, status, statement, confidence, evidence count, experience citations, review label, scope, provenance pr/outcome, metadata.relia_version, and accepted active review labels before relia check passes.
cmd/relia/main.go now preserves parsed object fields inside YAML list entries so provenance entries under memory/rules/*.yaml can be validated coherently.

schemas/experience-record.schema.json now preserves embedded signature class, check name, key, message fingerprint, and extraction confidence in experience records, with PRD alias fields accepted for class/check.
cmd/relia/main_test.go includes regression coverage for missing memory-rule schema fields, malformed provenance outcomes, and embedded experience signature details.

README.md, docs/dev/dev_guides.md, docs/architecture/architecture_guides.md, docs/architecture/decision-0002-product-contracts-and-privacy-defaults.md, and docs/product/prd.md document the repaired contracts.

resolved_review_findings.summary: Active memory rules already require review.label: accepted in both relia check and the memory-rule schema; repair-22 preserved that behavior.
relia check now rejects reviewed memory rules that omit schema-required fields such as kind, confidence, scope, metadata, object_type, schema_version, or provenance outcome details.
Experience-record signatures now retain the recurrence-pairing details required by the PRD instead of forcing those fields into a separate signature index.

summary.lifecycle_boundary: task-executor repair only; commit, PR update, scope closure, validation-gate, and post-merge evidence are left to their required workers
